description: This file defines the 'Details' feature within the 'Users' namespace, implementing user detail retrieval logic. It contains a query object, validation, and a handler that fetches user data from a database, generates a JWT token, and returns user information encapsulated in a 'UserEnvelope'.

classes.name: Details.Query
classes.description: A request object containing the username for which user details are to be retrieved.

classes.name: Details.QueryValidator
classes.description: Validates that the username in the query is not null or empty.

classes.name: Details.QueryHandler
classes.description: Handles the process of fetching user details from the database, generating a JWT token, and returning the data encapsulated in a UserEnvelope.

methods.name: Handle
methods.description: Handles the incoming query by fetching the user data, generating a token, and returning a UserEnvelope.
